summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded firmware experience in bare-metal C on STM32 microcontrollers: timer-triggered ADC, interrupt-driven capture and a hand-written I2C driver. Designed custom PCBs in EAGLE and debugged hardware-software integration failures from servo brown-out to sensor jitter. Git and GitLab for version control.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed Cortex-M4 peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver for real-time display.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built the Arduino controller in C++ with two-link IK, five servos, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors on a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles (4-bit A/B transition state machine, 2400 CPR) and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM on Arduino Due.
Added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control on STM32 with interrupt-driven UART commands from a Jetson running YOLOv8; FreeRTOS mutexes for task coordination, VL53L0X ToF sensing.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
